doclingProbe.detail: docling not found on PATH (spawn failed)

reason: You asked to extract .svg — a diagram/vector format. No rung reads it: there is no lightweight parser for vector diagrams, and Docling extracts document and image content, not vector graphics, so installing it would not help either.
remediation: Describe the diagram in prose yourself, or export a rendered raster (PNG) so an image-capable rung — Docling OCR, once installed — has pixels to read instead of vectors.
